meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 清理分支改动或指定文件里的九类 AI 代码坏味道：先用回归测试锁住行为，再按顺序多轮清理，最后跑测试、lint、类型检查等门禁验证，不过就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动里的 AI 代码坏味道时触发；不传参数则默认处理当前分支相对 main 的差异文件。

say.text: 帮我把这个分支的改动 deslop 一下
say.note: 先补回归测试锁住行为，再分类清理

say.text: 清理这几个文件里的 AI 代码坏味道：src/a.py、src/b.py
把超过 250 行纯代码的文件拆成职责单一的模块
say.note: 先给拆分方案，确认后执行

howto.what_en: Removes nine categories of AI-generated code smell from branch changes or a given file list. It locks behavior with green regression tests first, runs ordered multipass cleanup, then checks quality gates; reverts on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. With no arguments it defaults to the branch diff against merge-base main.

say_en.note: Adds regression tests first, then cleans in categories.

say_en.text: Remove AI slop from these files: src/a.py, src/b.py
say_en.note: Only the listed files are touched.

say_en.text: Split any file over 250 pure LOC into single-purpose modules
say_en.note: Shows you the split plan before executing.
